title: The Dream Thread
subtitle: A pink sloth, a sleeping giant, and absolutely no itinerary
credit: Every picture, film, cue and 3D figure was generated on the Sogni Supernet: the places painted with Krea 2 Turbo and Sogni Krea 2 Identity Edit from one reference picture of Simon, the objects traced with Segment Anything 3, every crossing rendered with MiniMax H3 (FastH3 first-and-last-frame, two-stage, 2K), the score composed with MiniMax Music 3 (a cue for each region, following you from place to place) and Simon stood up in 3D with Pixal3D. Built by Claude Code and Codex agents with a human approving every take.

intro.tagline: Wander 23 hand-built places, take every journey between them, and collect the figures hiding along the way.
